tagline.text: Your sales spreadsheet, explained in plain English

description.text: Upload a sales CSV or Excel file. Truesum checks the maths (quantity × price, discounts, missing costs), rates every sale High, Medium or Low on profit, says what stands out in plain sentences, and hands back an Excel workbook. Free, open source, nothing kept.
